instructions.allowed_edits: Coding agents may update only status, evidence, and notes fields unless the user explicitly changes scope.
instructions.completion_rule: A feature is passing only after evidence exists.

features.description: The harness records every route group, style entrypoint, command gate, source reference, dirty-tree risk, and design-system boundary before implementation continues.
steps: Inspect client/src/App.tsx, client/src/main.tsx, package.json, and the style entrypoints.
Record the full page matrix and validation commands in source-packet.md.
Write reports/flg-00-baseline-all-page-audit-report.md with command and inventory evidence.
features.evidence: reports/flg-00-baseline-all-page-audit-report.md records git status, route inventory, style line counts, and harness validator output.
features.notes: FLG-01 is unlocked to replace the broad material layer with compact utilities.

features.description: The material foundation uses compact tokens and reusable classes instead of a broad page-specific cascade, with fallbacks for reduced transparency and motion.
steps: Replace the overgrown liquid-materials.css behavior with a compact material utility layer.
Preserve import order and existing component contracts.
Verify pnpm check, pnpm test, pnpm build, and targeted browser screenshots.
features.evidence: reports/flg-01-design-system-foundation-report.md records compact material foundation, pnpm check, pnpm test, pnpm build, audit:ui, audit:baseline:quick, and Playwright screenshots under .cache/flg-01-qa.
features.notes: liquid-materials.css was reduced from 973 lines to 258 lines and no longer owns page layouts.

features.description: Public navigation, home, track, search, archive, taxonomy, about, login, and NotFound pages share the material language without duplicate CTA intent.
steps: Apply material utilities through shared public components and page-scoped classes.
Check header height, mobile stacking, empty states, loading states, and focus states.
Capture screenshots for public routes across the required viewports.
features.evidence: reports/flg-02-public-navigation-and-home-report.md records public component/page material adoption, pnpm check, pnpm test, pnpm build, audit:ui, audit:baseline:quick, 40 public-route screenshots under .cache/flg-02-qa, and reduced-preference checks.
features.notes: Home Start here and taxonomy desktop rail/list layout regressions were caught in screenshots and fixed. FLG-03 is unlocked for reader and agent companion work.

features.description: Article reader, discovery cards, TOC/actions, and agent companion gain layered material surfaces while prose, code, tables, formulas, and source cards remain readable.
steps: Apply material utilities to reader rails, summary surfaces, action controls, and agent shell.
Keep markdown content, source cards, and long-form reading surfaces high contrast.
Capture reader and agent-open screenshots across the required viewports.
features.evidence: reports/flg-03-reader-discovery-and-agent-report.md records reader/agent material adoption, pnpm check, pnpm test, pnpm build, audit:ui, audit:baseline:quick, 32 reader/agent screenshot states under .cache/flg-03-qa, source-card fixture screenshots, and reduced-preference checks.
features.notes: A wide-screen left reader rail attempt was rejected because it compressed the article column. The final reader keeps the main column readable and uses the TOC rail plus in-article guide as the reader rail system.

features.description: Manage, ManageAgent, and Editor receive dense Apple-grade surfaces without allowing owner CSS to override public pages.
steps: Audit owner-tools.css selectors for public-page bleed.
Apply material utilities to dashboards, forms, tables, editor toolbar, and editor canvas boundaries.
Capture owner and editor screenshots with keyboard focus checks.
features.evidence: reports/flg-04-owner-tools-and-editor-report.md records owner/editor material adoption, pnpm check, pnpm test, pnpm build, audit:ui, audit:baseline:quick, and 17 owner/editor/public-regression screenshot states under .cache/flg-04-qa.
features.notes: Local browser state was not admin-authenticated, so owner visual QA used Playwright tRPC fixtures for frontend-only data states. Public / was captured without owner fixtures and reported no owner CSS bleed.

features.description: Motion, route transitions, scroll progress, content rendering, container behavior, and transparency preferences are progressive and accessible.
steps: Add feature-detected route and scroll effects using existing platform APIs.
Verify reduced motion, reduced transparency, no horizontal overflow, focus visibility, and blur-disabled contrast.
Record performance and accessibility evidence in the phase report.
features.evidence: reports/flg-05-motion-performance-accessibility-report.md records route effect controller, compact global effects layer, pnpm check, pnpm test, pnpm build, audit:ui, audit:baseline:quick, and 40 preference-state screenshots under .cache/flg-05-qa.
features.notes: Reduced motion route animation measured none, reduced transparency and data-solid-surfaces fallback measured all sampled backdrop filters none, focus outlines remained visible, and max horizontal overflow was 0px.

features.description: The complete site passes command gates, route screenshots, audit scripts, and handoff documentation.
steps: Run pnpm check, pnpm test, pnpm build, audit:ui, and audit:baseline:quick.
Capture the full route matrix screenshots at all required viewports.
Update final report, continuity ledger, progress log, and handoff.
features.evidence: reports/flg-06-final-qa-and-handoff-report.md records pnpm check, pnpm test, pnpm build, audit:ui, audit:baseline:quick, 92 screenshots under .cache/flg-06-qa, and final handoff closure.
features.notes: Final QA covered 14 routes across 4 viewports plus Agent open, light mode, reduced motion, reduced transparency, and solid fallback states. Automated failures were 0, max overflow was 0px, and max non-editor header height was 72px.
